structuredInsights.observation: Repeat visits were recorded during baggage configuration.
structuredInsights.hypothesis: Users might be returning to the baggage configuration step because they are unsure of their selections or because the options are not clearly presented, leading them to revisit and adjust choices.
structuredInsights.proposedChange: Redesign the baggage configuration interface to provide clearer instructions, preview of selections, and a summary that confirms user choices before proceeding.
structuredInsights.suggestedExperiment: Conduct an A/B test comparing the current baggage configuration screen against the redesigned version with enhanced clarity and confirmation to see if revisits decrease.
